access.notes: Standard parameters for n-InSb (effective mass, deformation potential, dielectric constants, optical phonon energy, density, sound velocity, impurity concentration, refractive index) are available from semiconductor databases such as the Ioffe Institute NSM archive (http://www.ioffe.ru/SVA/NSM/Semicond/InSb/) or from standard literature (e.g., the book referenced in the paper).
Python 3 with NumPy, SciPy, matplotlib, installed via pip.

resources.name: Monte Carlo technique reference (Jacoboni and Reggiani)

access.notes: Standard one-particle Monte Carlo technique described in Jacoboni and Reggiani, Rev. Mod. Phys. 55, 645 (1983). Not required to be retrieved; the agent can implement the algorithm.
